captions: If you answer the same questions all day, your website can answer them for you, at night and on Sundays too.
Hours, address, delivery and payment options: whatever people ask you every day belongs on your website, front and center.
Every repeat question is time you're not spending on selling. A clear website, with what people always ask right there, gives you that time back.
